_doc: Owner mandate 2026-08-31. Finishes here are LOCKED. Do not edit their renderers, their recipes, their palettes or their spec decks. Do not 'improve', 'optimise', 're-gate' or re-bake them. If a change is unavoidable (an engine-wide contract change), it requires an explicit owner ask in conversation, and the reference bake must be re-approved by the owner's eye. Owner: 'It needs to be protected and NEVER CHANGED - at all costs.'

xlab_hologram_metal.name: Hologram Metal
xlab_hologram_metal.why: Owner: 'one of my gold standards right now for how it stands out and what it does. It needs to be protected and NEVER CHANGED - at all costs.'

xlab_dichroic_skin.name: Dichroic Skin
xlab_dichroic_skin.why: Owner: 'Same goes for Dichroic Skin.' Gold standard, never change.

ff_truchet_glass.name: Truchet Glass
ff_truchet_glass.why: Owner: 'a design that 1000x percent works ... UNIQUE design with a spec map that follows the design - good all around. GREAT ALL AROUND. We need MORE like this.' This is the reference implementation of the FOLLOW axis - highest amp_corr in the calibration set.

impossible_cinder_pulse.name: Cinder Pulse
impossible_cinder_pulse.why: Owner: 'in IMPOSSIBLE FINISHES there's only 2 right now but both really stand up because of how much they have going for them.'

impossible_hologram_noir.name: Hologram Noir
impossible_hologram_noir.why: Owner: same verdict as Cinder Pulse - 'both really stand up'.

follow_exempt.xlab_hologram_metal: The mechanism IS spec-independence: micro-zones of contrasting spec materials that make colour shift and dance, deliberately not keyed to the paint's own structure. It measures amp_corr -0.004 and the owner calls it a gold standard, so FOLLOW does not apply. This is the ONLY finish in the catalog with this exemption as of 2026-08-31; adding another requires an owner verdict quoted in this file, not an agent's judgement.
